integrity: The uniform torsion-order identity follows from the source formulas \(T-I=-A^{-\mathsf T}(A+A^{\mathsf T})\) and \(\operatorname{adj}(A+A^{\mathsf T})=D(A)pp^{\mathsf T}\) with primitive \(p\). The five Smith forms were replayed from the source table by exhaustive exact minor computation.
scientific_limitations: The statement is restricted to the five positive rank-four Euler-matrix mutation classes classified in arXiv:2609.39766v1.
The coinvariants are numerical Grothendieck-lattice coinvariants; no categorical orbit object or topological realization is asserted.
The scalar Euler degree already distinguishes the five mutation classes; the new information is its torsion interpretation and the full Smith group.
title: Euler degree is the torsion order of the numerical Serre–Coxeter coinvariants
